description.n_claims: claims with a positive building paid amount (real USD > 0)
description.share_sfha: share of known-zone policy-years in zones A* or V*
description.share_v: share of known-zone policy-years in zone V*
description.share_x: share of known-zone policy-years in zone X
description.hist_claims_1990_2008: paid claims in the county, loss years 1990-2008
description.n_all: all claims, paid or not (sensitivity count)
description.n_major: paid claims from the 10 largest named events of 2010-2024
description.share_zone_unknown: share of policy-years without flood zone
description.partial_year: exposure year flagged partial in zone_year (none in 2010-2024)
description.n_policy_rows: number of policy records (not a policy count)
